origin_detail: aiter.paged_attention_ragged -> csrc/cpp_itfs/pa/pa_ragged.py (jinja-templated HIP, JIT-compiled). Launches paged_attention_ll4mi_QKV_mfma16_kernel + reduce kernel. Same 'll4mi' lineage as vLLM rank-8 paged_attention (carries 'Copyright The vLLM team' + vllm::Fp8KVCacheDataType), but a generalized superset (ragged kv_indptr/kv_page_indices/kv_last_page_lens interface, MTP, logits soft cap, sliding window, q_scale, head/gqa loop generalization).
notes: Absent from the formal_run selection pipeline because every formal_run sglang combo hit a structural extraction gap for this kernel (summary.md: 'aiter paged_attention_ragged: structural extraction gap ... Skipped'). The only materialized extraction is the earlier results/qwen3-30b-a3b_sglang_hip batch, used here as canonical. canonical/src/aiter_meta/hsa (108M of prebuilt asm .co blobs) was trimmed: the cpp_itfs HIP build only needs csrc/ + 3rdparty/composable_kernel headers.

test_status.correctness: PASS (reference-based; validated against an analytic paged-attention reference)

original_findings: No analytic reference: scripts/_runtime.py REFERENCES had no entry for 'paged_attention_ragged' (or any attention op). reference_for('paged_attention_ragged','aiter') returned None, so run_correctness() fell back to the else-branch: kernel run twice with the SAME seed=42, only checking out1==out2 — a determinism check, not math-correctness (a deterministic all-zero kernel passed).

Degenerate inputs: build_inputs generated structurally-inconsistent paged-KV metadata (kv_indptr was random ints, not a prefix sum, because the positional aiter call has no arg names so the name-keyed structured generators never fired). context_len went negative/garbage -> kernel read out of range -> output was all NaN; with compare(equal_nan=True) the NaNs still 'passed'.

changes: Added _ref_paged_attention_ragged: analytic decode attention softmax((K@q)*scale [+alibi][soft_cap]) @ V over the per-seq gathered KV pages (NHD/HND, GQA, block_size>=1), registered as REFERENCES['aiter:paged_attention_ragged'] so run_correctness compares kernel vs reference.

Added make_consistent_paged_attention_ragged: deterministic in-place repair of the positional launch — kv_indptr -> valid monotonic prefix sum (0..num_pages); kv_page_indices -> in-bounds unique block ids; kv_last_page_lens in [1,block_size] when block_size>1; plus a 4x query gain so the softmax is non-degenerate (output ~O(1)) and the bf16 atol can't mask scale errors.
task_runner.py routes all three modes through _prep_inputs() = build_inputs + normalize_aiter_call + consistency repair.
fix_applied.verification: All 8 cases PASS vs reference (real_vs_ref max abs diff ~0.0156 << bf16 atol 0.05). Negative tests now FAIL as expected: out*=1.5 -> FAIL (diff 1.609), zero-out -> FAIL (diff 3.25). Pre-fix these passed.
fix_applied.validates: kernel computes standard paged decode attention correctly (matches the analytic reference).

audit.broader_note: The same original weakness still affects rank-8 vllm paged_attention and the triton unified/paged-attention entries (no attention reference + name-less positional inputs). The reference + consistent-input pattern added here can be ported to them (reuse _ref_paged_attention_ragged for 'vllm:paged_attention' with its block_tables/seq_lens layout).
